observations: Multiple used tires stacked in a tire shop/yard; several loose tires visible in the foreground.
Tire sidewalls show heavy wear, dirt, and markings; no clear readable brand/model text in the provided photos.
No tire size (e.g., 195/65R15) is clearly readable from these images.
No tread depth measurement, DOT date, or condition close-ups are shown.

claims.evidence: Photos do not show any clearly readable brand/country-of-origin markings, DOT codes, or model/size that would confirm 'Belgium' or 'first grade'.

risks.risk: Tire size is unknown; wrong size will make the purchase unusable for the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tire sidewall showing the full size (e.g., 195/65R15) for at least one tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/unknown used tires (worst case for buyer usability).

risks.risk: Condition/remaining tread depth is unknown; tires may be near-worn-out or unevenly worn.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tread blocks plus a tread depth measurement (or a ruler/coin test) for at least 1-2 tires.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn tires (worst case: low tread).

risks.risk: Age/DOT date is unknown; older tires can be unsafe even if tread looks okay.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code/date on the sidewall for at least one tire.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older used tires (worst case: age risk).

risks.risk: Repairs/patches/bulges/sidewall damage are unknown; these can fail quickly.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of sidewalls and any repaired areas, including both sides of at least 1-2 tires.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/unsafe used tires (worst case).

risks.risk: Quantity and exact set (pair/4/assorted) is unclear from photos.
risks.proof: Tell the exact number of tires and whether they are a matched set (same size and tread pattern).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an uncertain quantity/assortment (worst case for matching).

proof_requests: Clear sidewall photo showing the full tire size (e.g., 195/65R15) for each tire type you’re selling.
Clear DOT date photo for at least one tire (and ideally all if mixed).
Tread depth measurement photo (or close-up tread + ruler/coin test) for at least 1-2 tires.
Close-up photos of sidewalls for cracks, bulges, cuts, and any repairs (both sides).
Confirm quantity and whether they are a matched set (same size and tread).
response.reason: From the photos, the tires are used and worn-looking, but the key details needed to price correctly (exact size/model, DOT age, and condition/tread depth) are not readable or shown. Without that, any price would be guesswork.
